root: ^This is the beginning of the visual novel demo, please give a warm welcome to...
^Yuzu is not here today, but lucky you because it means you get me instead!
^Oh my, what a privilege you get indeed, please no touching, I'm a feast for the eyes only
^Okay so let's check Yuzu notes.... what a mess, let's do it my way instead, what do you want to know first?

Choice: ^I think I would rather see Yuzu
SelfIntro: ^Good choice, I am the center topic after all
^As you can see I am a bit of an important person, my main work is being a secretary for Calindra
^Of course it's a crucial work, there is lot more to it that it seems, I think you could even say that I am the backbone of the country
^As for my tastes, yes I only eat refined food, my favorite ones being apples, the sweet ones only of course
^My main hobbies are shopping for clothes, piano and just letting people enjoy how beautiful I am, some people would pay for that you know?
^How lucky you are to get me for free!
^And of course I think it's my duty to-
^Eh? Wait management is speaking to me... Hmm.. But...
^Well okay, let's go back to the engine if they think it's sooo important
^What do you want to know about it?
Yuzu: ^Eh!? Am I not good enough for you?
^Of course, I guess I shouldn't expect everyone to appreciate the opportunities they are given
^Well, Yuzu is not there so you better appreciate the chance you got
Engine: ^The engine is the medium we use so I can speak to you, magnificent isn't it? Almost as great as me!
^You already some of its feature, showing text letter by letter, displaying choices and sprites...
^Along with these little buttons your the right!
^Let's start with the "Auto" button, it allow you to pass the dialogues automatically when they end, after all it should be the engine job to pass dialogues, not yours!
^Feel free to test it for the rest of this technical preview
^Then we have the "Hide" button, its use is pretty straighfoward too, it allows to hide the interface to better see the background image
^Beautiful landscape isn't it? Might be a bit blurry for you but I assure you that from where I am, it truly is magnificent
^After that we have the "Skip" button, as its name says, it allows to skip text, try it, I'll ramble for a bit in my native language and stop you when I'm done
^Amazing isn't it? It feels like no time passed!
^Of course be careful with that, you wouldn't want to miss too much of what I say!
^Our last feature, and the most important one is all about me and how my sprite can change, for that let me show you more about my wardrobe
^For example this is what I wear when I go outside, it's a bit more dressy while keeping a casual tone
^But for very important events, I of course have clothes fitting it, I wouldn't want to be seen as a plebeian in the middle of a ball
^And with that we are done with our technical demo, anything else you would like to know?
Ending: ^Thanks for passing by, and of course if you want to see me again you can always come back
^You'll be redirected to the main screen, check the others scenes too!
